maria: opened a docs hotfix PR to add the incident status link + a short KB workaround after INC-1420. need quick reviews and a backport to stable.

maria: PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601

kevin: looking now. please call out which pages need the status link and the exact one-line workaround you want in the KB.

maria: added the status link in the incident notes and a Known impact bullet in /kb/outages.md. workaround: temporarily reduce prefix batching or disable KV-prefetch for affected workloads for ~6-12h.

ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #601 — preview: https://deploy-preview-601--docs.redwoodinference.net

kevin: quick pass — the Python snippet still uses the old sync helper. propose switching to async and the v2 namespace:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import asyncio

client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))

async def summarize():
    resp = await client.text.generate(prompt="Summarize the outage impact in one sentence")
    print(resp.output_text)

asyncio.run(summarize())
```

maria: thanks — pushed that change. also added a tiny migration note about client.text.* vs top-level helpers.
